recent_news.headline: Waste Hauler Insurance Rates: Liquid Waste Operations See 30–50% Pollution Liability Premiums
recent_news.summary: Liquid waste with pollution exposure adds 30-50% to insurance costs. Article outlines 2026 insurance benchmarks for waste haulers, telematics discount opportunities, and cost-reduction strategies. Significant overhead challenge for operators in septic and liquid waste sectors.
